items.change: The party arrived in Brandonsford following a treasure map whose marked locations they could not recognize.
items.impact_basis: Beat_1 establishes the party's driving pursuit, a treasure map leading into unknown land, which frames what they are doing.
items.lasting_basis: Beat_1 sets up an unfound treasure the party will keep pursuing in later Sessions.

items.change: Eric the Reeve offered 1000 gold to kill a black dragon that had torn off a woodsman's arm, but Sir Phidipaldi insulted him and challenged him to a duel.
items.impact_basis: Beat_14 gives a 1000-gold bounty, beat_15 identifies the black dragon, and beat_17 shows the party's champion slapping and challenging the bounty-giver.
items.lasting_basis: The standing bounty (beat_14), Hilda's offer (beat_9) and strained relations with Eric (beat_17) will shape later Sessions.

items.change: Reginald the frog warned Dr. Uriah that a trickster Clurichen comes from the riverbanks into town every night.
items.impact_basis: Beat_6 reveals a nightly local danger the party should avoid.
items.lasting_basis: Beat_6 describes a recurring nightly visitor that will likely come up again, possibly tied to the vanishing ale.

items.change: The party learned Bentley's restocking shipment was a week overdue and nothing has reached town in months.
items.impact_basis: Beat_12 and beat_27 reveal a supply problem hurting the town, a small discovery alongside the dragon news.
items.lasting_basis: Beat_12 raises an unexplained missing shipment that Wayman asked about and may be pursued later.

items.change: Drop Dead Ned, a murderous thief with a killer wasp, offered to hire on with Dr. Uriah for 100 gold a week, and Uriah said he would think about it.
items.impact_basis: Beat_19 makes an offer of a dangerous hireling that is pending.
items.lasting_basis: Beat_19 leaves the offer open, so Ned is likely to return.

items.change: Farmer Gill offered Dunk his shabby mule Shamus for 100 gold or dragon-killing work, and Dunk slept in the barn to think it over.
items.impact_basis: Beat_23 and beat_26 record an open offer for an ordinary animal, a small adjustment.
items.lasting_basis: Beat_26 leaves the decision pending, so it may come up again but matters little.

items.change: Sir Phidipaldi agreed to help Quinn for 100 gold by staging a fake ale delivery to catch whoever empties his stock each night.
items.impact_basis: Beat_31 reveals the mystery and beat_32 seals a paid agreement and plan.
items.lasting_basis: Beat_32 sets up a sting that will play out in a later Session.

items.change: Bentley stopped Sir Phidipaldi's quarrel with Eric and banished him to the Golden Egg for the night while his friends stayed.
items.impact_basis: Beat_21 separates Sir Phidipaldi from the party and sends him to the other tavern, enabling the Quinn deal.
items.lasting_basis: Beat_21 mainly affects this night, though it sours Sir Phidipaldi with Bentley.

items.change: Gill revealed that Warwick the smith is growing paranoid and keeps an unsellable mithril chain shirt on display.
items.impact_basis: Beat_27 adds gossip about a local figure and a coveted item, a small detail.
items.lasting_basis: Beat_27's mithril shirt and paranoid smith may come up if the party visits the smithy.

items.change: The party talked their way past a night watchman into Brandonsford.
items.impact_basis: Beat_3 is a routine entry; beat_1's map is told by thread_1.
items.lasting_basis: Entry and town layout (beat_2, beat_4) matter little afterward.
items.encounter_basis: Arrival and gate passage is routine logistics; the map arrival is already told by thread_1.

items.change: Dr. Uriah spoke with Reginald the frog, who warned of the Clurichen.
items.impact_basis: Beat_6's warning is the only change and is told by thread_3.
items.lasting_basis: The Clurichen warning may recur, as covered by thread_3.
items.encounter_basis: The frog conversation's only substance is the Clurichen warning, which thread_3 already tells.

items.change: At the Clumsy Fox, Sir Phidipaldi took up the dragon bounty talk with Eric the Reeve but ended up slapping him and being thrown out.
items.impact_basis: Beat_14, beat_17 and beat_21 together reshape relations with the town's leadership and the bounty.
items.lasting_basis: The bounty and strained relations will matter later, as told by thread_2 and beat_21.
items.encounter_basis: The central interaction, the bounty and duel challenge leading to expulsion, is already told by thread_2 and beat_21; Hilda's flirtation adds only colour.

items.change: Dunk spent the night drinking with Farmer Gill, hearing the legend of Sir Brandon and that Gill's sons were hunting the dragon.
items.impact_basis: Beat_24 and beat_25 add dragon history and rival hunters, while beat_23's mule offer is minor.
items.lasting_basis: Gill's sons hunting the dragon (beat_25) and Brandon's fairy sword lore (beat_24) are likely to come up again.
items.encounter_basis: Dunk's solitary night with Gill gives personal context and town lore, Sir Brandon's fairy sword and Gill's sons hunting the dragon, not captured by the mule thread.

items.change: At the Golden Egg, Sir Phidipaldi agreed to stage a fake ale delivery for Quinn.
items.impact_basis: Beat_32's agreement is the central change, told by thread_7.
items.lasting_basis: The sting will play out later, as thread_7 records.
items.encounter_basis: The scene's central event is the Quinn deal, which thread_7 already tells.
